packages/market/src/lonora_market/__init.name: Market package
packages/market/src/lonora_market/__init.description: Marks the market-data code as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/market/src/lonora_market/broker.name: Broker market source
packages/market/src/lonora_market/broker.description: Picks the right source of market data for one broker account.

packages/market/src/lonora_market/cache..name: Market cache
packages/market/src/lonora_market/cache..description: A short-lived store of recent market data so it loads faster.

packages/market/src/lonora_market/candle.name: Candle store
packages/market/src/lonora_market/candle.description: Saves the broker's official price bars under the same account record as its quotes.

packages/market/src/lonora_market/candle.name: Candles for analysis
packages/market/src/lonora_market/candle.description: Checks a series of price bars and writes them out exactly for analysis files, without rounding or resampling.

packages/market/src/lonora_market/detect.name: Market detectors
packages/market/src/lonora_market/detect.description: Versioned, exact observations over real prices, reused for live watching and replay.

packages/market/src/lonora_market/econom.name: Economic calendar
packages/market/src/lonora_market/econom.description: Reads the owner's economic-calendar sources, serves the upcoming events, and keeps a cached copy.

packages/market/src/lonora_market/health.name: Market-data health
packages/market/src/lonora_market/health.description: Checks that quotes, candles and account data are fresh and sound before they are used.

packages/market/src/lonora_market/instru.name: Instrument matching
packages/market/src/lonora_market/instru.description: Works out which of a broker account's symbols a request for an instrument means.

packages/market/src/lonora_market/models.name: Market snapshot type
packages/market/src/lonora_market/models.description: Defines the shape of a market snapshot.

packages/market/src/lonora_market/provid.name: Market provider
packages/market/src/lonora_market/provid.description: The common way the rest of the system reads quotes and candles.

packages/market/src/lonora_market/quotes.name: Quote freshness
packages/market/src/lonora_market/quotes.description: Checks whether a quote is recent enough to use.

packages/market/src/lonora_market/relati.name: Market correlations
packages/market/src/lonora_market/relati.description: Works out, on the server, how two instruments have moved together over matching closed bars.

packages/market/src/lonora_market/runtim.name: Market runtime
packages/market/src/lonora_market/runtim.description: The always-on part that keeps broker-neutral market observations up to date.

packages/market/src/lonora_market/sessio.name: Trading-session clock
packages/market/src/lonora_market/sessio.description: Works out the current trading sessions and the trading week from time zones, handling daylight saving.

packages/market/src/lonora_market/snapsh.name: Market snapshot
packages/market/src/lonora_market/snapsh.description: Builds a compact set of market facts across timeframes from closed bars — facts only, never trade signals.

packages/market/src/lonora_market/stream.name: Quote stream
packages/market/src/lonora_market/stream.description: Streams a symbol's quote, sending an update only when the price changes.

packages/market/src/lonora_market/struct.name: Price structure
packages/market/src/lonora_market/struct.description: Finds swing highs and lows and recent lines in closed bars — facts, never trading decisions.

packages/market/src/lonora_market/watch_.name: Watch trigger check
packages/market/src/lonora_market/watch_.description: Decides whether a watch may fire again yet, respecting its cooldown.

packages/market/src/lonora_market/watch_.name: Watch health
packages/market/src/lonora_market/watch_.description: Records meaningful changes in a watch's health.

packages/market/src/lonora_market/watch_.name: Watch transitions
packages/market/src/lonora_market/watch_.description: The exact rule that moves a watch forward, used both live and in replay.

packages/market/src/lonora_market/watche.name: Market watchers
packages/market/src/lonora_market/watche.description: Evaluates each live market watch against fresh data and fires it when its condition is met, disabling one that keeps failing.
